THE ROADMAP'S NAMED /plan DECISION IS MADE, NOT PUNTED: Docker Compose is REJECTED in favour of a documented one-command install script (`npm run brew` -> a cross-platform Node script). Decisive source-grounded reason: P1's describeListenAddresses() enumerates os.networkInterfaces() inside the listening process, so under Compose it would print the container bridge IP (172.x) rather than the host LAN IP - destroying this milestone's single most important affordance, with the only fix (network_mode: host) unavailable on Docker Desktop for macOS/Windows. Three supporting grounds: no published image is possible without the author hosting distribution infrastructure (the milestone forecloses hosting), so Compose is the install-script footprint PLUS Docker Desktop; a bind mount/volume hides the brewer's own DB file that the milestone promises they control; and the usual 'SQLite needs a compiler' argument does not apply here at all because better-sqlite3 resolves to the pure-JS local workspace shim over node:sqlite (verified: node_modules/better-sqlite3 is a symlink to packages/better-sqlite3-shim). Shipping both paths also explicitly rejected. FOUR SOURCE-VERIFIED FINDINGS binding on execution, none inherited from roadmap prose: (1) README.md is STILL the unmodified Vite starter template ('# React + TypeScript + Vite', plugin list, React Compiler note) - it describes no part of production setup and must be deleted, not appended to (AC-22). (2) The Node floor is pinned at major 24 because packages/better-sqlite3-shim imports node:sqlite's DatabaseSync and NOTHING in the tree passes --experimental-sqlite (swept, zero hits) - so CI pins node-version 24 (the documented floor, not 'latest') and AC-21 enforces lockstep across nodeVersion.mjs / ci.yml / README.md.
